finding: §6.4 claims the gofmt gate change is 'guarded going forward by the gate itself', but that guard is self-referential and does not protect against the exact regression this release fixes. The gate (golangci-lint with formatters enabled) catches a gofmt-dirty *source file*, yet nothing catches silent removal of the new `formatters: enable: [gofmt]` section from `.golangci.yml`. If that section is later dropped, the blind spot re-opens and no test fails. The 'no Go unit test' claim itself is honest (a YAML config change has no Go unit), but the accompanying guard is weaker than stated.

resolved.evidence: Incorporated into spec §6.5: added a deterministic guard test asserting .golangci.yml formatters section enables gofmt; §6.4 reworded to drop the self-referential 'guarded by the gate itself' claim.

suggestion: Add a cheap deterministic guard test that reads `.golangci.yml` and asserts a `formatters:` section enables `gofmt` (e.g. TestGolangciConfigEnablesGofmt), so removing the section fails CI. Reword §6.4 to describe this config-assertion guard rather than 'the gate itself'.
